## Who is AJDM Jakiur Rahman?

AJDM Jakiur Rahman is a Dhaka-based full-stack developer, DevOps engineer, WordPress and Laravel specialist, Android developer, Python automation engineer, and founder & CEO of Lunova Digital.

Professional career:
- 2018: PHP Developer at Genuine Software Solutions
- 2020: PHP & WordPress Developer at Techpirates (built commercial WordPress plugins sold globally)
- 2023: PHP Developer at Kodezen
- 2024: Promoted to Senior PHP Developer at Kodezen
- 2025: Promoted to Team Lead at Kodezen
- 2026: Founded Lunova Digital

He has delivered 100+ projects for clients across 15+ countries: USA, UK, Middle East, Europe, Southeast Asia.

## What does AJDM Jakiur Rahman do?

He designs and builds production software across the full stack:

1. Laravel development — SaaS platforms, REST APIs, Filament admin panels, multi-tenant architecture, Stripe billing, VPS deployment
2. WordPress plugin development — custom plugins, WooCommerce extensions, Gutenberg blocks, SaaS integrations, license systems
3. DevOps engineering — CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx, AWS, VPS setup, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, Cloudflare
4. Android app development — Kotlin and Java, MVVM, Firebase, push notifications, offline support, Google Play deployment
5. Python automation — Scrapy web crawlers, Selenium/Playwright bots, ETL pipelines, data processing, business workflow bots
6. SaaS development — multi-tenant platforms, subscription billing, analytics dashboards
7. Custom CRM/ERP — sales pipelines, HR, inventory, financial reporting, role-based dashboards
8. REST API development — versioned, documented, authenticated APIs
